business_problem: Cisco's Customer Experience team had to analyze more than 50 signals across structured and unstructured systems to prepare renewal proposals, but the manual process left too little time to build personalized, data-driven proposals and prepare well for customer engagements.
solution_summary: Cisco built the AI Renewals Agent with Mistral to automate a renewal-proposal workflow that previously required CX teams to manually interpret more than fifty signals across structured and unstructured systems. The agent sits over on-prem customer data and uses text-to-SQL techniques to pull relevant facts from multiple platforms, then assembles account context so teams can prepare tailored renewal proposals and customer-engagement plans faster. Cisco and Mistral's Applied AI team are fine-tuning the underlying models for Cisco-specific data and knowledge and scaling the deployment across Cisco's GPU cluster. The result is an agentic workflow that keeps sensitive data on premise while turning scattered account signals into draft proposals and preparation material for a large global CX organization.

solution_components.name: AI Renewals Agent
solution_components.role: Orchestrates renewal-proposal preparation by combining signals and drafting account-specific proposal inputs.

solution_components.name: Mistral LLMs
solution_components.role: Provide the language understanding and text-to-SQL reasoning used to interpret Cisco-specific renewal data.

solution_components.name: Cisco GPU cluster
solution_components.role: Runs the fine-tuned deployment at scale for Cisco's CX organization while keeping data on premise.

data_flow: Structured and unstructured customer signals remain on premise across multiple internal platforms; the AI Renewals Agent uses Mistral LLMs and text-to-SQL techniques to pull and interpret those signals, assemble account context, and return draft renewal proposals plus customer-engagement preparation material to CX teams.
business_outcome: Cisco expects the AI Renewals Agent to cut renewal-proposal preparation time by up to 20%, raise productivity across its large CX organization, and improve customer satisfaction by giving teams more time to tailor renewal discussions around each account's needs.
metrics: Up to 20% time reduction (estimated) in creating renewal proposals and preparing for customer engagements.
